api_base.description: The API base URL for Qualifire. If not provided, the `QUALIFIRE_BASE_URL` environment variable is checked.

api_key.description: The API key for Qualifire. If not provided, the `QUALIFIRE_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

assertions.description: Custom assertions to validate against the output. Each assertion is a string describing a condition.

content_moderation_check.description: Enable content moderation to check for harmful content (harassment, hate speech, etc.).

evaluation_id.description: Pre-configured evaluation ID from Qualifire dashboard. When provided, uses invoke_evaluation() instead of evaluate().

grounding_check.description: Enable grounding verification to ensure output is grounded in provided context.

hallucinations_check.description: Enable hallucination detection to detect factual inaccuracies.

on_flagged.description: Action to take when content is flagged. 'block' raises an exception, 'monitor' logs but allows the request.

prompt_injections.description: Enable prompt injection detection. Default check if no evaluation_id and no other checks are specified.

tool_selection_quality_check.description: Enable tool selection quality check to evaluate quality of tool/function calls.
